svg.title: ACT training as a conditional VAE
svg.desc: A batch of real demonstrations gives images, the joint state and the next 100 actions; a CVAE encoder reads a learned class token, the state and the 100 actions and outputs the mean and log variance of a 32 dimensional latent; a sample z is drawn with the reparameterization trick; the ACT network from the Inference tab predicts the chunk with z as its first token; the loss is the masked L1 error plus ten times the KL divergence to a unit Gaussian; AdamW updates all weights at a constant learning rate.
svg.text: ACT learns to rebuild the recorded chunk.

g.text: real teleoperated demonstrations · last 10 % of episodes held out
statistics come from the dataset, not the training split
reads the true actions, so it is dropped at inference
learned CLS · Linear 6 → 512 for s and each a · + fixed 1D sine positions (102)
4 encoder layers · d 512 · 8 heads · FFN 3200 · post-norm
z = μ + exp(½ log σ²) ⊙ ε, ε ~ N(0, I)
gradients flow to μ and log σ² through z
one of 32 dimensions shown; at inference z = 0, the prior mean
the network from the Inference tab
z replaces the zero latent as the first encoder token
dropout 0.1 everywhere · ImageNet-initialized backbone, BatchNorm frozen
lr 1e-5 for the backbone and for the rest (two parameter groups)
|â − a| over 100 steps (every 4th drawn), padded steps masked
L1 = Σ mask · |â − a| / (6 · valid steps)
KL = −½ Σj​ (1 + log σj​² − μj​² − σj​²), mean over batch
the KL keeps q(z | s, a) near N(0, I), so z = 0 is a typical style
no scheduler: the rate stays constant
100,000 steps · checkpoint and held-out L1 every 5,000
held-out L1 does not measure stacking success

svg.text: source · lerobot train, ACT preset · 100,000 steps · click a block or use the arrow keys
